fields.description: Fallback policies used when not configured on the Shift Type.
fields.label: Default Policies

fields.description: Default policy used when an employee exceeds their grace pool. Override per Shift Type.
fields.label: Attendance Penalty Policy

fields.description: Default policy used for unpermitted absences. Override per Shift Type.
fields.label: Absence Penalty Policy

fields.description: Policy used to penalize the minutes that exceed an employee's Approved Attendance Pre-Authorization. Only Factor and Fixed Per Hour policies are valid.
fields.label: Pre-Authorization Surplus Policy

fields.description: Working days per month used to derive the daily rate from base salary (daily_rate = base / month_days). Common values: 22 (working days), 26 (six-day week), 30 (calendar days). Default is 30.
fields.label: Month Days

fields.description: Inputs for converting penalty minutes into a deduction amount. Used by the Factor penalty type and the daily-rate basis for the Penalty Matrix.
fields.label: Salary Calculation

fields.description: When checked, newly created Attendance Pre-Authorizations skip HR review and are immediately Approved. Use this when HR is the only role creating pre-authorizations and review is unnecessary.
fields.label: Auto Approve Pre-Authorization

fields.description: If checked Discipline Penalties will be created as auto processed, else will be pending.
fields.label: Auto Process Discipline Penalty

fields.description: The Additional Salary will be created as Draft if this field is not checked.
fields.label: Auto Submit Additional Salary

fields.description: Number of days after a pre-authorization's date before unconsumed records (Draft / Pending Approval / Approved) are auto-marked Expired by the daily scheduler. An Approved pre-auth is expired only if it was never consumed by a submitted Attendance — this prevents stale approvals from being absorbed by a late-arriving attendance amendment. Default is 7.
fields.label: Pre-Authorization Expiry (Days)

fields.description: Base: daily rate = base / month days. Total: daily rate = (base + variable) / month days.
fields.label: Salary Basis
